raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 15, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly switched the organization behind the Free Software Directory from the Free Software Foundation (FSF) to the Free Software Foundation Europe (FSFE) and concluded Georg Greve was the founder, contradicting the cited evidence that the Directory is an FSF project and that FSF was founded by Richard Stallman in 1985.
